subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled the Giants eating prisoners who tried to steal rather than escape.
source_quote: He remembered how the Giants ate the ones who tried to steal

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wants to return home, but the location of his home is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Grygum just wanted to go home

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir refused to be drowned by the creature's grappling ability.
source_quote: I decide that I do not wish to be drowned

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized he had a reason to grapple.
source_quote: I think, "I have a reason to grapple."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir used his monastic deflection technique to absorb bludgeoning force.
source_quote: I use my monastic deflection technique, absorbing a portion of the bludgeoning force and limiting the pain.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observed the creature attempting to consume Thorin while still grappled.
source_quote: The image is strange—I hold it, yet it tries to consume another.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted the creature was felled by persistent magic, not a final weapon strike.
source_quote: The creature is felled not by a final weapon strike, but by the relentless, quiet efficacy of persistent magic.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the creature's resistance to fire and the blast still hurting it.
source_quote: The Grik is naturally resistant to fire, but the blast hurts.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized he could not use Guiding Bolt because Zalthir's spell hid the creature.
source_quote: I cannot use Guiding Bolt because Zalthir's spell hides the creature.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz considered whether using Tasha's Caustic Brew honored Bahamut.
source_quote: So am I not, in a curious way, honoring my god in this way?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that one of the material components of Tasha's Caustic Brew is a toothbrush.
source_quote: One of the material components is a toothbrush, you know, for afterward.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed the blinded Grick missing all three attacks against the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: The blinded Grick misses all three of its subsequent attacks against the Ember Vanguard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remarked, "Should have fled faster," as the creature died.
source_quote: Should have fled faster.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz pretended to brush his teeth while looking at Zalthir.
source_quote: Looking at Zalthir, I pretend to brush my teeth.

subject: the mossy swamp
fact: The mossy swamp, if left alone, could threaten us later.
source_quote: this "mossy swamp", if left alone, could threaten us later.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the vines from these constructs are useful for crafting magical items and are valuable.
source_quote: the vines from these constructs are useful for crafting magical items and are valuable.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the creature is near the shore of a lake more than 10 feet deep.
source_quote: The creature is near the shore of a lake that is more than 10 feet deep.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that the creature can grapple.
source_quote: Recalling how it can grapple

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted the terraces are suffused with faerzress and filled with vegetation.
source_quote: The terraces lining the northern walls are suffused with faerzress, and I notice that this place is filled with vegetation.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed water trickling from the cavern walls into a terraced irrigation system.
source_quote: I see water trickling from the walls of this vast cavern being channeled into a crude yet effective terraced irrigation system.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed the thick, sweet smell from thousands of glowing fungi.
source_quote: A thick, sweet smell fills the air from the thousands of fungi of all colors and sizes, many glowing with a strange, inviting light.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Gasbide is a 'Builder' and a supporter of Sovereign Phylo.
source_quote: He is a 'Builder' and, according to Basidia, a "supporter of Sovereign Phylo."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed Gasbide's obsession with surface architecture and his confusion about windows.
source_quote: What is a window?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted Zalthir’s Minor Illusion of a scaled-down structure.
source_quote: Zalthir, seeing an opening to secure an advantage, focuses and conjures a small-scale structure using Minor Illusion.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed Gasbide’s realization that the illusion was scaled down.
source_quote: Oh! And he goes, are you an architect?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted Gasbide’s dream of building a fungal tower to break through the Underdark.
source_quote: I dream of building a fungal tower even greater than Yggmorgus... I hope to use it to break through the Underdark to the surface world, possibly with the aid of Aromikos

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted Gasbide’s confusion about the sun and its harm to myconids.
source_quote: They are distraught and ask how they can build things that will protect them from the thing I call a sun.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Gasbide has no clear understanding of Araumycos, only that it is part of a great celebration.
source_quote: he has no clear understanding of what Araumycos is, only that "it is part of a great celebration to come," promised by Sovereign Phylo.

subject: the great awakening
fact: The impending "great awakening" is tied to the mythical "great celebration," but its nature and purpose are not fully understood.
source_quote: The impending "great awakening" is tied to this mythical "great celebration".

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wondered if the great celebration promised by Phylo tomorrow is connected to Araumycos.
source_quote: I wonder if this has anything to do with the celebration promised by Phylo tomorrow.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz decided to nerd out with Gasbide on construction and design.
source_quote: "I'll nerd out with them for a little while," I tell everyone.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the creature is a swamp creature and the fire is squelched.
source_quote: the fire is squelched

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that Grygum's Spirit Guardians creates a persistent zone of damage.
source_quote: this spell creates a persistent zone of damage

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the creature's speed is drastically reduced.
source_quote: its speed is drastically reduced

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that the creature thrashed and succeeded in attacking Zalthir.
source_quote: It thrashes, using its tendril in an attempt to attack me, and succeeds.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the creature attempted to escape Zalthir's hold and engulf Thorin.
source_quote: It then attempts to escape my hold and engulf Thorin.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that Thorin strained and escaped the creature's engulf.
source_quote: He strains and escapes.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Grygum's game of K’tharr-li is being continued and the creature is found.
source_quote: So Daz continues his game of K’tharr-li and finds the creature.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz sensed that Grygum is worried, though he did not know why.
source_quote: I sense Grygum is worried. I don't know what.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Basidia accepted the Grick after it was stripped for its head.
source_quote: We had stripped the Grik for its head.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that Basidia is concerned but sighs, acknowledging the animation will continue.
source_quote: Basidia is concerned, but then sighs. The animation will continue and be successful.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Basidia leads them toward the Circle of the Builders.
source_quote: Basidia then leads us toward the next segment of this bizarre cultural tour: the Circle of the Builders.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Grygum asked if Rump-a-dump and Stool would like to join them.
source_quote: Grygum asks if Rump-a-dump and Stool would like to join us.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Basidia assured them they are happy among their kind.
source_quote: Basidia assures that they are pretty happy among their kind.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Grygum persisted in asking Basidia if they could come along.
source_quote: Grygum persists, and he tells Basidia that he would be thrilled to have them come along.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed Gasbide scrutinizing them with undisguised curiosity.
source_quote: He scrutinizes us with undisguised curiosity.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Gasbide asked if they are from above.
source_quote: And... and are you from, from above?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed Grygum confirming they are from the Great Bright with performative pomp.
source_quote: Yes, we are from the Great Bright.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Grygum gave generalized, unhelpful answers about buildings.
source_quote: Well, we have some that are tall, and some that are big

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed Gasbide cutting through Grygum’s fluff with precise engineering questions.
source_quote: No, no, no, no, no, like, how are they built? I want you to... is it, like, what shape do they have? What materials do you use? How many windows? How many doors?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Zalthir agreed to be called an architect.
source_quote: Let's go with that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed Gasbide’s unbridled excitement about his dream structures.
source_quote: Gasbide's excitement is now unbridled.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that Gasbide asked if zurkhwood mushroom can be used as an equivalent material.
source_quote: Can... this zurkhwood mushroom be used as an equivalent?
